columns.name: kit_number
columns.reason: Static parts/modification kit identifier attached to the component, known while it is in service.

columns.name: shift_team
columns.reason: Administrative maintenance-shift assignment, known before any removal decision.

columns.name: inspection_method
columns.reason: Records how the last inspection was performed, so it is final before the prediction point.

columns.name: hours_since_inspection
columns.reason: Elapsed-time counter computable from the last inspection date at prediction time.

columns.name: zone_code
columns.reason: Static airframe zone designation, fixed by configuration.

columns.name: fleet_avg_egt_margin
columns.reason: Fleet-level trend aggregate that can be computed from history available at prediction time.

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.reason: Supplier of record for the part, fixed at procurement.

columns.name: egt_margin_q2
columns.reason: Historical quarterly engine-trend aggregate observed while the unit is in service.

columns.name: engine_position
columns.reason: Installed position on the airframe, fixed at installation.

columns.name: line_station
columns.reason: Administrative line-maintenance station assignment, known in advance.

columns.name: aog_hours
columns.reason: Aircraft-on-ground time is a downstream consequence of the unplanned removal event, accrued after it.

columns.name: bleed_valve_cycles
columns.reason: Accumulated usage counter read from in-service monitoring data.

columns.name: condition_monitor_index
columns.reason: In-service condition-monitoring score; highly predictive but computed before any removal.

columns.name: start_count_since_shop
columns.reason: Cumulative start counter since the last shop visit, known at prediction time.

columns.name: cycles_since_overhaul
columns.reason: Cumulative cycle counter since last overhaul, known at prediction time.

columns.name: oil_consumption_q1
columns.reason: Historical quarterly oil-consumption aggregate from in-service monitoring.

columns.name: shop_visit_delta_days
columns.reason: Reads as the gap between planned and actual shop visit, which is how a removal is classified unscheduled.

columns.name: eng_order_class
columns.reason: Engineering/work-order class encodes planned versus unplanned work, an input to how the target label is assigned.

columns.name: ata_chapter
columns.reason: Static ATA system classification of the component.

columns.name: shelf_life_code
columns.reason: Static storage/shelf-life category of the part number.

columns.name: torque_spec_rev
columns.reason: Document revision level, fixed by the applicable manual at prediction time.

columns.name: ambient_temp_p50
columns.reason: Percentile of operating ambient temperature from accumulated flight history.

columns.name: replacement_part_cost_usd
columns.reason: A replacement cost is booked only once the part has actually been replaced, i.e. after the removal.

columns.name: part_series
columns.reason: Static part design series, fixed at manufacture.

columns.name: lease_flag
columns.reason: Ownership/lease status of the asset, known in advance.

columns.name: task_card_rev
columns.reason: Revision of the applicable task card, a document attribute fixed before the work.

columns.name: egt_margin_q4
columns.reason: Quarterly engine-trend aggregate from the observation history; no stated cutoff places it after the prediction point.

columns.name: tool_calibration_id
columns.reason: Administrative calibration record identifier, not derived from the outcome.

columns.name: manual_rev
columns.reason: Maintenance-manual revision in force, fixed before the prediction point.

columns.name: station_code
columns.reason: Static base/station assignment.

columns.name: crew_base
columns.reason: Static crew-base assignment for the aircraft.

columns.name: config_mod_level
columns.reason: Current configuration/modification standard of the unit, final while in service.

columns.name: storage_class
columns.reason: Static handling/storage classification of the part.

columns.name: vibration_exceed_flag
columns.reason: In-service vibration exceedance observed by monitoring before any removal decision; causal but not outcome-derived.

columns.name: n2_vib_p90
columns.reason: Percentile of measured N2 vibration from accumulated in-service data.

columns.name: hangar_bay
columns.reason: Facility/bay assignment attribute, administrative rather than outcome-derived.

columns.name: oil_debris_flag
columns.reason: Chip/oil-debris detection from in-service monitoring, recorded before the removal decision.

columns.name: egt_margin_q3
columns.reason: Quarterly engine-trend aggregate from the observation history, same window family as the other margins.

columns.name: planner_group
columns.reason: Maintenance planning group ownership, an administrative assignment.

columns.name: log_page_prefix
columns.reason: Formatting/station prefix on log-page numbering, administrative metadata.

columns.name: access_panel_code
columns.reason: Static access-panel designation for the component location.

columns.name: tail_suffix
columns.reason: Aircraft registration identifier fragment, static.

columns.name: consumable_lot
columns.reason: Lot identifier of consumables on record for the unit, administrative traceability data.

columns.name: oil_consumption_q2
columns.reason: Historical quarterly oil-consumption aggregate from in-service monitoring.

columns.name: sector_length_hr_q1
columns.reason: Historical average sector length from flown operations.

columns.name: teardown_finding_score
columns.reason: Teardown occurs only after the component is removed and records why the removal was warranted.

columns.name: egt_margin_q1
columns.reason: Historical quarterly engine-trend aggregate observed while the unit is in service.
